<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
if ( ! function_exists( 'is_plugin_active' ) ) {
  require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';
}
$errors = array();
$ok = array();
$stylesheet = get_option( 'stylesheet' );
if ( 'maison-calista-theme' !== $stylesheet ) {
  $errors[] = 'Theme not active, stylesheet=' . $stylesheet;
} else {
  $theme = wp_get_theme();
  $ok[] = 'Theme active: ' . $theme->get( 'Name' ) . ' v' . $theme->get( 'Version' );
  if ( is_wp_error( $theme->errors() ) && $theme->errors()->has_errors() ) {
    $errors[] = 'Theme errors: ' . $theme->errors()->get_error_message();
  } else {
    $ok[] = 'No theme errors object';
  }
}
if ( get_option( 'maison_calista_demo_installed' ) ) {
  $ok[] = 'Auto-setup flag set';
} else {
  if ( function_exists( 'maison_calista_install_demo_content' ) ) {
    try {
      maison_calista_install_demo_content();
      $ok[] = 'Manual install_demo_content completed';
    } catch ( Throwable $e ) {
      $errors[] = 'install_demo_content fatal: ' . $e->getMessage();
    }
  } else {
    $errors[] = 'maison_calista_install_demo_content missing (theme functions not loaded?)';
  }
}
$home = (int) get_option( 'page_on_front' );
if ( $home > 0 ) {
  $ok[] = 'Front page ID ' . $home;
} else {
  $errors[] = 'Front page not set';
}
$required = array( 'home', 'about-maison-calista', 'the-residence', 'care-support', 'family', 'activities', 'restaurant', 'stays-pricing', 'gallery', 'contact', 'privacy-policy', 'cookie-policy' );
$missing = array();
foreach ( $required as $slug ) {
  if ( ! get_page_by_path( $slug ) ) {
    $missing[] = $slug;
  }
}
if ( $missing ) {
  $errors[] = 'Missing pages: ' . implode( ',', $missing );
} else {
  $ok[] = 'All 12 pages created';
}
$locations = get_theme_mod( 'nav_menu_locations', array() );
if ( empty( $locations['primary'] ) ) {
  $errors[] = 'Primary menu not assigned';
} else {
  $ok[] = 'Primary menu assigned';
}
$theme_obj = wp_get_theme();
if ( ! $theme_obj->is_block_theme() ) {
  $errors[] = 'Not detected as block/Gutenberg FSE theme';
} else {
  $ok[] = 'Gutenberg FSE block theme detected';
}
if ( ! file_exists( get_template_directory() . '/theme.json' ) ) {
  $errors[] = 'theme.json missing';
} else {
  $ok[] = 'theme.json present (FSE)';
}
if ( ! file_exists( get_template_directory() . '/templates/index.html' ) ) {
  $errors[] = 'templates/index.html missing';
} else {
  $ok[] = 'Site Editor template index.html present';
}
$patterns = glob( get_template_directory() . '/patterns/*.php' );
$count = is_array( $patterns ) ? count( $patterns ) : 0;
if ( $count < 17 ) {
  $errors[] = 'Expected 17 patterns, got ' . $count;
} else {
  $ok[] = 'Patterns on disk: ' . $count;
}
$plugin_needles = array( 'polylang', 'wordpress-seo', 'fluentform' );
$active = (array) get_option( 'active_plugins', array() );
foreach ( $plugin_needles as $needle ) {
  $found = false;
  foreach ( $active as $a ) {
    if ( false !== strpos( $a, $needle ) ) {
      $found = true;
      $ok[] = 'Plugin active: ' . $a;
      break;
    }
  }
  if ( ! $found ) {
    $errors[] = 'Plugin not active: ' . $needle;
  }
}
try {
  $out = do_shortcode( '[mc_site_logo][mc_language_switcher][mc_whatsapp][mc_maps][mc_price key="wellbeing"]' );
  if ( false !== strpos( $out, 'To be confirmed' ) || false !== strpos( $out, 'mc-site-logo' ) || false !== strpos( $out, 'mc-lang' ) || false !== strpos( $out, '€' ) ) {
    $ok[] = 'Shortcodes render without fatal';
  } else {
    $errors[] = 'Unexpected shortcode output';
  }
} catch ( Throwable $e ) {
  $errors[] = 'Shortcode fatal: ' . $e->getMessage();
}
$ok[] = 'PHP ' . PHP_VERSION;
$ok[] = 'WP ' . get_bloginfo( 'version' );
$report = array();
$report[] = '=== Maison Calista activation test (STRATO-like: PHP 8.2 / WP latest) ===';
foreach ( $ok as $line ) {
  $report[] = 'PASS: ' . $line;
}
foreach ( $errors as $line ) {
  $report[] = 'ERROR: ' . $line;
}
$report[] = 'RESULT=' . ( $errors ? 'FAIL' : 'PASS' );
$text = implode( "\n", $report ) . "\n";
@mkdir( '/output', 0777, true );
file_put_contents( '/output/activation-result.txt', $text );
echo $text;
